title: Buffs - Chem Buffs
blurb: Every chem and serum and what it really does, straight from the game files. Find the best chem for your build, compare up to three side by side, or open any chem for its buffs, side effects and when it works.
count: There are currently 69 chems and serums.

basics.title: Chem basics
lines: Most chems have a chance to make you addicted. The chance is shown with each chem.
Chem Fiend (Luck) makes chems last 100% longer.
Chems with the same kind of buff replace each other. Chems with different buffs stack.
